name: opus-realign-issue524-20260918-01
head: 85b9792fa7f7d26508bfd48efcc2718cc510a22b
note: Scoped realignment of the symmetrization lemma under the main disposition line '524 MAIN DISPOSITION' and the meta authorization of 2026-09-18. WHAT IS PROVED: the approximate form the source proof establishes, exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx (source shape: val*(G) = 1 - eps and eps' > eps give a symmetric projective strategy of value >= 1 - eps') and exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_lt_value (slack shape: every delta > 0 gives a symmetric projective strategy within delta of the game value), plus four supports (Strategy.value_le_one, bddAbove_range_strategy_value, Strategy.value_le_game_value, nonempty_strategy_of_nonempty_answer, exists_strategy_lt_value). The proof is the source argument verbatim: the supremum property of Game.value supplies a strategy above the strict lower bound, and main's already proved value-preserving exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_strategy symmetrizes it. No compactness, limit or attainment argument anywhere. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: exists_symmetric_projective_strategy is untouched - same statement, same sorry, same **Unfaithful:** marker - and blueprint lem:symmetric-strat stays as printed with no proof-level leanok. Nothing is renamed; the exact form stays an open source gap. OPTION CHOSEN (the disposition offered two): RETAIN the sorry-carrying printed declaration and add the approximate form beside it as a new formalization-only node lem:symmetric-strat-approx. Reason: this is the lower-churn option and the one the repository's proof-gap protocol already prescribes - the printed statement is not known to be false for nonempty answer alphabets, only its proof is blocked, so AGENTS.md requires the source-labelled node to stay as printed without leanok and the scope-restricted result to be a separate node whose restriction is displayed. Replacing the node would have retired a source statement the project still tracks and contradicted the register's existing 'source statement kept as printed' entry. BOUNDARY: both approximate declarations carry Nonempty G.Answer explicitly. That is the source's nonempty finite answer alphabet and is load-bearing only in the Lean domain, where an empty answer alphabet admits no strategy while Game.value is the totalized supremum of the empty set. This adopts PR 540's empty-answer refutation; 540 was NOT re-audited and its bounded metadata fix and review history are untouched. This branch is based on current github/main (which lacks 540's note edits) and its gap-note edit is a new section before the conclusion, disjoint from 540's hunks, so both can stand. ONE JUDGEMENT CALL: the paper's side condition 0 <= eps is kept in the approximate statement for recognizability but is not needed by the proof, so its binder is named _heps rather than dropped or masked with a linter option; dropping it would strengthen the theorem, keeping it is conservative. PACKAGING: the new declarations went into a new module MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Symmetrization.lean because appending them to StrategyClasses.lean pushed it to 1065 lines, past the 1000-line guard (the pre-push gate caught this and the second commit moved them, unchanged). VERIFICATION: lake env lean on both touched Lean files clean (the only warning is the pre-existing sorry on exists_symmetric_projective_strategy); lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.Symmetrization success; #print axioms from a probe file outside the worktree gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for all six new declarations and for exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_strategy, sorryAx only for the retained printed theorem; dup_check check reports no duplicate on github/main for any added name; checked-push pre-push gate passed; ci.sh 601 conclusion success at 85b9792f (build, blueprint-render, paper-gaps, blueprint-sync, file-length, proof-debt, proof-evasion; statement-origin skipped); blueprint_leanok_axioms.py --ci exit 0, PASS 1660 FAIL 0, and 'No proof-level leanok-tagged declarations depend on sorryAx', so the new node's leanok is honest. The 3 remaining warnings and the 4 duplicate private-helper candidates are pre-existing and unrelated. The project sorry count is unchanged. NEEDS A FRESH INDEPENDENT REVIEW - this session authored the packet and did not review it. Audit: audits/2026-09-18_symmetrization-realignment-524.md. name: opus-review-pr601-20260917-01

note: Fresh independent review of the statement-realignment PR for issue 524, round 1 (no earlier marked review existed). name: opus-realign-issue524-20260918-01
head: 85b9792fa7f7d26508bfd48efcc2718cc510a22b
note: Scoped realignment of the symmetrization lemma under the main disposition line '524 MAIN DISPOSITION' and the meta authorization of 2026-09-18. WHAT IS PROVED: the approximate form the source proof establishes, exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_approx (source shape: val*(G) = 1 - eps and eps' > eps give a symmetric projective strategy of value >= 1 - eps') and exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_lt_value (slack shape: every delta > 0 gives a symmetric projective strategy within delta of the game value), plus four supports (Strategy.value_le_one, bddAbove_range_strategy_value, Strategy.value_le_game_value, nonempty_strategy_of_nonempty_answer, exists_strategy_lt_value). The proof is the source argument verbatim: the supremum property of Game.value supplies a strategy above the strict lower bound, and main's already proved value-preserving exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_strategy symmetrizes it. No compactness, limit or attainment argument anywhere. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: exists_symmetric_projective_strategy is untouched - same statement, same sorry, same **Unfaithful:** marker - and blueprint lem:symmetric-strat stays as printed with no proof-level leanok. Nothing is renamed; the exact form stays an open source gap. OPTION CHOSEN (the disposition offered two): RETAIN the sorry-carrying printed declaration and add the approximate form beside it as a new formalization-only node lem:symmetric-strat-approx. Reason: this is the lower-churn option and the one the repository's proof-gap protocol already prescribes - the printed statement is not known to be false for nonempty answer alphabets, only its proof is blocked, so AGENTS.md requires the source-labelled node to stay as printed without leanok and the scope-restricted result to be a separate node whose restriction is displayed. Replacing the node would have retired a source statement the project still tracks and contradicted the register's existing 'source statement kept as printed' entry. BOUNDARY: both approximate declarations carry Nonempty G.Answer explicitly. That is the source's nonempty finite answer alphabet and is load-bearing only in the Lean domain, where an empty answer alphabet admits no strategy while Game.value is the totalized supremum of the empty set. This adopts PR 540's empty-answer refutation; 540 was NOT re-audited and its bounded metadata fix and review history are untouched. This branch is based on current github/main (which lacks 540's note edits) and its gap-note edit is a new section before the conclusion, disjoint from 540's hunks, so both can stand. ONE JUDGEMENT CALL: the paper's side condition 0 <= eps is kept in the approximate statement for recognizability but is not needed by the proof, so its binder is named _heps rather than dropped or masked with a linter option; dropping it would strengthen the theorem, keeping it is conservative. PACKAGING: the new declarations went into a new module MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/Symmetrization.lean because appending them to StrategyClasses.lean pushed it to 1065 lines, past the 1000-line guard (the pre-push gate caught this and the second commit moved them, unchanged). VERIFICATION: lake env lean on both touched Lean files clean (the only warning is the pre-existing sorry on exists_symmetric_projective_strategy); lake build MIPStarRE.QPBT.Games.Symmetrization success; #print axioms from a probe file outside the worktree gives [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] for all six new declarations and for exists_symmetric_projective_strategy_of_strategy, sorryAx only for the retained printed theorem; dup_check check reports no duplicate on github/main for any added name; checked-push pre-push gate passed; ci.sh 601 conclusion success at 85b9792f (build, blueprint-render, paper-gaps, blueprint-sync, file-length, proof-debt, proof-evasion; statement-origin skipped); blueprint_leanok_axioms.py --ci exit 0, PASS 1660 FAIL 0, and 'No proof-level leanok-tagged declarations depend on sorryAx', so the new node's leanok is honest. The 3 remaining warnings and the 4 duplicate private-helper candidates are pre-existing and unrelated. The project sorry count is unchanged. note.head: 4dbf45bc550a55673e36729c4205a1cc72e17463
note.note: Artifact packet A-NONVACUITY. New leaf module MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/NonVacuity.lean answering the two vacuity questions of the 2026-09-19 ITP-readiness audit section 3; only other touched file is the MIPStarRE.QPBT umbrella, for the import line. Q1 (satisfiable hypotheses), fully delivered: nonVacuousParams is an explicit AdmissibleParams family (q=2^(2n+1), m=1, d=n+1) giving nonempty_admissibleParams; exists_pauliBasisTest_strategy_value_one transports exists_spcc_value_one (Test/Completeness.lean:266) along pauliBasisTestSymm_toGame, which is rfl, so the SymmetricStrategy-to-Strategy coercion a reader had to check by hand is now a declaration; pauli_soundness_hypotheses_satisfiable and pauli_soundness_applies_to_honest_strategy state joint satisfiability and the unconditional instantiation of the theorem at eps=0 for every admissible P. Q2 (non-trivial conclusion), delivered beyond the fallback: tendsto_deltaQld_nonVacuousParams shows that for ANY a>=1 and b>0, hence for whatever constants pauli_soundness produces, deltaQld a b 0 m d q tends to 0 along the family, because the (m*d)^a prefactor is polynomial while q^(-b) and 2^(-b*m*d) both decay at geometric rate (2^b)^-(n+1); exists_admissibleParams_deltaQld_lt turns that into 'below any eta>0, in particular below 1'; pauli_soundness_nontrivial combines Q1 and Q2 into a single statement bounding the state distance and both operator distances strictly below eta; tendsto_deltaQld_eps_zero records right-continuity in eps at 0 so the eps=0 section is visibly the limiting case. Key Mathlib lever: tendsto_pow_const_div_const_pow_of_one_lt. Honest limits, stated in the module docstring AND in the PR body: this is the eps=0 section along a chosen parameter family, not a uniform rate; no threshold eps0>0 at fixed parameters, no comparison against the cheap bound on pauliOperatorDistanceA/B at fixed parameters, and nothing about the numerical size of a and b, which the source leaves implicit. No sorry/admit/axiom/native_decide; no existing statement or definition changed. dup_check check --name clean for all 12 new names. #print axioms from a probe outside the worktree: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound for all nine public declarations (nonVacuousParams and nonempty_admissibleParams need only propext). lake build of MIPStarRE.QPBT.Test.NonVacuity and of the MIPStarRE.QPBT umbrella both successful; checkdecls resolved all 1846 blueprint declarations. ci.sh 657 at exact head 4dbf45bc: conclusion success (build 41s, blueprint-sync 243s, proof-evasion 54s, proof-debt 15s, paper-gaps and file-length green; blueprint-render and statement-origin skipped). ci.sh flagged the blueprint axiom audit as required for this diff: ran scripts/blueprint_leanok_axioms.py --ci in the branch worktree, PASS 1825 decls / FAIL 0, no proof-level leanok declaration depends on sorryAx.
